answer: The well digger marks each foot on the windlass post, and the post stands where every man in the village can read it. Proof of lime burner kiln via chalk load tally is the marking: a kiln the burner fires only after 40 loads of chalk are tipped, each load weighed at the kiln mouth. First the ridge, marked when the digging began; then the vine, marked when the water came; the echo is the post itself, sunk deep beside the shaft. A cheat must mark 29 false feet and sink 29 false posts, and the village still draws no water from his well.
